Do not copy its conversation content or its far-right tool panel.

The user selected Work "lucyna" and needs to browse its files and inspect Git context. Within the existing workbench, the right main content area has exactly TWO primary tabs: "对话工作" and selected "工作区文件". This is not a new global Git navigation destination. Main header shows "lucyna", "WSL · Ubuntu-22.04", branch "codex/git-workspace", and small theme/settings controls. Beneath the primary tabs, show secondary views "浏览", "改动 5", "历史", "分支", "Worktree", with "浏览" selected.

The content has a modest file-navigation pane and a spacious document reader. File pane is rooted at the Work, showing SESSION.md, work.json, expanded repos / lucyna / docs with selected architecture.md, notes, scripts. Distinguish folder icons, file icons and changed-file M/A indicators. Reader breadcrumb "repos / lucyna / docs / architecture.md"; actions "查看差异" and "在对话中讨论". Render a legible Markdown architecture note headed "Lucyna 工作区架构" with a few compact paragraphs and a small Work → Git service → WSL Git diagram. Bottom status says "当前仓库 lucyna · 未提交 5 · 已暂存 2". Keep only familiar desktop controls, practical density, fine separators, and visible focus. Add a quiet top strip "设计预览 · 演示数据". All Chinese labels must be readable and spelled exactly. No decorative cards or extra right sidebar.
